results.title: Virar: Youths Hold Protest, Back Delhi's Jantar Mantar Stir Against Student Lathi-Charge
results.description: Youths in Virar staged a protest outside Viva College, Virar West, backing the Jantar Mantar stir in Delhi. Carrying the national flag, they condemned the alleged lathi-charge on students and demanded Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Students and parents joined the hour-long protest (11 am–12 noon), voicing solidarity with Delhi's agitators.
